n1e8e7da645.headline: The White House is considering a presidential visit to Saudi Arabia

nb28f157fb1.headline: Establishment of the Business Committee of the Board of Directors of Ecopetrol S.A.

nb28f157fb1.why: Ecopetrol is Colombia's state-controlled oil company, and board governance changes can affect strategy and investor perception of the company.

nad446f1d8f.headline: Bulgarian foreign, energy ministers quit, deepening coalition crisis
nad446f1d8f.summary: Bulgaria's foreign and energy ministers resigned on Monday after the populist ITN party quit the governing coalition, according to Reuters.
nad446f1d8f.why: Political instability in Bulgaria, an EU member, can affect investor confidence, fiscal policy and energy decisions, and therefore its government bonds and the euro-area periphery.
